t: This is the former Willesden Hippodrome, near Willesden Junction in Harlesden. It was a theatre, later a cinema. Its architect was Frank Matcham, who spent forty years designing and refurbishing theatres and music halls. He is credited with over ninety new theatres and a further eighty refurbishments across the United Kingdom. Among his London buildings are the Coliseum, the Palladium, Hackney Empire and Shepherd's Bush Empire. The Hippodrome is a suburban cousin of those famous houses, from the same busy and prolific hand.
